status.name: Name
status.restart_service_description: The qBittorrent container will be stopped and started again. Active transfers are interrupted and resume automatically once the service is back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bt_port_helper: Forward this TCP and UDP port on the upstream router to accept incoming peer connections.
settings.bt_port_enabled: Open the port in the firewall
settings.downloads_dir_helper: Absolute path of an existing directory, writable by the app. Leave empty to use the qbittorrent-downloads volume.
settings.timezone_helper: IANA time zone used inside the container, for instance Europe/Budapest.
settings.umask_helper: Octal umask applied to downloaded files, for instance 002.
settings.downloads_dir_invalid: Must be an absolute path without spaces or special characters
settings.downloads_dir_not_found: Directory not found on the installation node
settings.downloads_dir_not_writable: Directory is not writable by the app: check its owner and permissions
settings.bt_port_invalid: Must be a port number between 1024 and 65535
settings.bt_port_in_use: Port already in use on the installation node
settings.umask_invalid: Must be an octal value like 002
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.auth_whitelist_helper: Comma separated subnets in CIDR notation, for instance 192.168.0.0/24. Clients in these networks reach the WebUI without logging in. Leave empty to always require a password.
settings.auth_whitelist_invalid: Must be a comma separated list of subnets, like 192.168.0.0/24
